The metallic texture lacks the fine micro-scratches or uniform brushing often seen on real used irons. The reflections around the steam holes are slightly soft and inconsistent with rigid metal geometry.
The connection between the power cord and the iron body is slightly ambiguous and lacks a clear strain relief boot or defined mechanical joint, appearing somewhat fused.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the red sticker on the soleplate. Real irons often have safety warnings or brand logos; if the text is gibberish, it is a strong indicator of AI generation. Also, verify if the steam holes look like punched metal (with slight burrs or depth) or just flat dark circles painted on the surface.
